title: Chapter 424: Capturing Liu Hong
content:
Chapter 424: Capturing Liu Hong

"Impossible, stop bluffing me here, I have millions of troops."

Liu Hong immediately denied it, but a trace of doubt arose in his heart.

"Are you going to surrender? Or let me do it myself?" Wang Shuo stared at Liu Hong with sharp eyes and said sternly.

"Want to catch me? Then we have to see if you have the ability."

Liu Hong was puzzled. How could Wang Shuo, a mid-level general, have the confidence to capture a high-level general alive?

Wang Shuo stopped talking and stepped forward with a gun.

Liu Hong also made up his mind that as long as he could control Wang Shuo, there might be a reversal in this battle.

So Liu Hong also urged his horse forward and fought with Wang Shuo.

Liu Hong also used a long spear, and the two long spears collided and sent sparks.

Feeling the force from the handle of the spear, Liu Hong was shocked.

The opponent's mid-level general was actually stronger than his high-level general.

Liu Hong no longer held back and used various moves in succession.

Wang Shuo was not in a hurry, but fought with the opponent patiently.

The masters he would meet in the future would probably be high-level generals, and he still lacked experience in dealing with high-level generals.

He should be able to easily control this opponent now, so he naturally had to get familiar with the combat methods of high-level generals from outside the domain.

Zhao Bangde had already controlled all the surrendered soldiers at this time, and was only waiting for the war to end before making a decision.

Liu Hong noticed that there was another large group of masters on the opposite side, surrounding him.

He was even more flustered.

He couldn't easily defeat even a small intermediate general. Was he really going to die here today?

Wang Shuo was very calm, and now he just waited to capture Liu Hong alive, so that this battle could end perfectly.

After fighting with Liu Hong for several rounds and being familiar with his various moves, Wang Shuo decided to end the battle.

One move of "Iron Chain Binding" plus one move of "Flying Dragon in the Sky".

Directly killed Liu Hong's mount.

Liu Hong himself was also injured, although not fatally, but very embarrassed.

Wang Shuo took advantage of Liu Hong's embarrassment and put the tip of his gun on his neck to subdue him.

At this point, the war came to an end.

[The Great Sophora Domain was completely incorporated into the Shenwu Empire, and the system functions were synchronized with the Shenwu Empire. ]

Wang Shuo clearly felt that most of the system functions had disappeared.

At the same time, there was an additional [Shenwu Empire Chat Channel] in the chat channel.

But at this time, the channel was empty. After Wang Shuo explored it, he found that this channel needed to be created by himself.

Just like the village-level channel established before.

As for the attribute panel, task panel, etc., they all disappeared.

For the people in the Great Sophora Domain, it was like growing up at this time, and no one came to take care of them and ask them to do anything.

But at the same time, there was no power to protect them.

The last layer of the barrier disappeared, and the army of the Great Sophora Domain could also step into the outside world.

Wang Shuo immediately organized the army and quickly captured a small city in the north of the Great Wall.

The main city of the Iron Blood Lord is the Iron Blood City, and the city located on the edge of the Steel Great Wall is called Guancheng.

There were only a few troops stationed in the city, and Wang Shuo easily captured the city.

The reason for capturing this city was that it was like the gateway to the Great Huai Territory.

As a vital throat, if it was controlled by others, the Great Huai Territory would have to shrink in one place forever.

As long as this place was controlled, the passage to a wider world would be mastered.
